_comment: Curated answers for the 67 collision-verified anchor questions, used to
bootstrap the cache so a demo starts warm instead of missing on the first
query. Hand-written rather than model-generated on purpose: they are
consistent in tone and available with no Bedrock access at all.
Entries created from this file are stored with source='seed', which is what
keeps them distinguishable from answers the model actually produced. Without
that field a plausible seeded answer is indistinguishable from a real one,
which is worse than an obvious placeholder, not better.
The product is fictional: a file storage and collaboration tool. Questions
come from data/eval_pairs.json and must stay worded identically, since the
threshold work in knowledge/learned.md sections 10 and 11 was measured

answers.How do I reset my password?: Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in screen and enter your email. We'll send a reset link that stays valid for one hour. If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder before requesting another.
answers.Why can't I log in?: The most common causes are a mistyped password, an account still awaiting email verification, or a browser holding a stale session. Try a private window first, then reset your password. If you see 'account locked', that clears automatically after 30 minutes.
answers.How do I change the email address on my: Go to Settings > Account > Email and enter the new address. We'll send a confirmation link there, and the change takes effect once you click it. Your old address keeps working until then.
answers.How do I permanently delete my account?: Settings > Account > Delete account. We hold the account in a recoverable state for 30 days, after which all files and metadata are erased permanently. Export anything you want to keep first.
answers.How long until I get logged out from bei: Sessions expire after 14 days of inactivity by default. Workspace admins can shorten this under Admin > Security, and choosing 'Remember me' at sign-in extends it to 30 days.
answers.How do I set a new password while I'm al: Settings > Security > Change password. You'll need your current password to confirm. Changing it signs out every other device, which is the fastest way to revoke access you no longer want.
answers.How do I turn on two-factor authenticati: Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication. You can use an authenticator app or SMS, and we strongly recommend the app. Save the recovery codes somewhere offline, since they're the only way back in if you lose the device.
answers.Can I merge two accounts into one?: Yes. From the account you want to keep, go to Settings > Account > Merge and enter the other account's email. Files, comments, and share links transfer over. Any active subscription on the closed account is prorated and refunded.
answers.Can I get a refund for my subscription?: Annual plans are refundable in full within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans aren't refunded, but cancelling stops the next charge and you keep access until the period ends. Contact support to start a refund.
answers.How do I cancel my subscription?: Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription. You keep full access until the end of the period you've already paid for, then the account drops to the free plan. Nothing is deleted, though files above the free storage limit become read-only.
answers.How do I upgrade to a paid plan?: Settings > Billing > Change plan, pick the tier, and add a payment method. The upgrade applies immediately and you're charged a prorated amount for the rest of the current period.
answers.How do I downgrade to a cheaper plan?: Settings > Billing > Change plan and select the lower tier. The change takes effect at the end of your current billing period, and the difference is credited toward the next invoice. Check your storage usage first, since files over the new limit become read-only.
answers.Do you offer discounts for students?: Yes, 50% off any paid plan with a valid .edu address or student ID. Apply through Settings > Billing > Apply discount. Verification takes a day or two and the discount renews annually.
answers.How do I update my payment method?: Settings > Billing > Payment method. Adding a new card replaces the old one immediately, and we'll retry any failed invoice against it right away.
answers.How do I download an invoice for my subs: Settings > Billing > Invoices lists every charge with a PDF download. Invoices include your billing address and VAT number if you've added one under Billing details.
answers.What's the price difference between mont: Annual billing works out to two months free, roughly 17% cheaper than paying monthly. You can switch at any time from Settings > Billing, and switching to annual credits whatever you've already paid for the current month.
answers.Why is my file upload failing?: Uploads usually fail for one of three reasons: the file exceeds your plan's size limit, your account is out of storage, or the connection dropped partway. Large uploads resume automatically if you retry from the same browser within 24 hours.
answers.How much storage do I get on the free pl: The free plan includes 5 GB. Paid plans start at 100 GB per user, and team plans pool storage across the workspace rather than capping each person individually.
answers.How do I export all my data?: Settings > Account > Export data. We build an archive of your files plus a JSON manifest of comments, share links, and version history, then email you a download link. Large accounts can take a few hours.
answers.Can I recover a file I accidentally dele: Deleted files sit in Trash for 30 days and can be restored with one click from there. After 30 days they're gone permanently. Workspace admins on team plans can recover files any member deleted.
answers.Is there a maximum file size I can uploa: 2 GB per file on the free plan and 50 GB on paid plans. There's no limit on how many files you upload, only on total storage.
answers.How do I find duplicate files in my acco: Use Tools > Find duplicates. It matches on content rather than filename, so renamed copies are still caught, and it groups results so you can keep one and remove the rest in a single action.
answers.Can I restore an older version of a file: Yes. Open the file, click History, and pick a version to preview or restore. Free accounts keep 30 days of versions, paid accounts keep unlimited history. Restoring creates a new version rather than overwriting, so nothing is lost.
answers.How do I delete multiple files at once?: Select files with shift-click or ctrl-click, or use the checkbox in the list header to select everything in a folder, then choose Delete. Everything selected goes to Trash and can be restored for 30 days.
answers.Can I share a folder with someone outsid: Yes, unless your workspace admin has restricted external sharing. Use Share > Invite by email, and they'll get access without needing a paid seat. External collaborators can be limited to view-only under Share settings.
answers.How do I add a teammate to my workspace?: Admin > Members > Invite, then enter their email and pick a role. They'll get an invitation link valid for seven days. On paid plans each member consumes a seat and is billed prorated from the day they accept.
answers.How do I change someone's permission lev: Open the folder, click Share, and use the dropdown beside the person's name to switch between Viewer, Commenter, and Editor. Changes apply immediately, including to anyone currently viewing the folder.
answers.How do I transfer ownership of a file to: Open the file, go to Share > Advanced, and choose Transfer ownership. The new owner has to accept, after which you keep editor access unless they change it. Ownership can only transfer within the same workspace.
answers.How do I leave a comment on a shared doc: Select the text or region you want to comment on and press the comment icon, or use ctrl+alt+M. Type @ followed by someone's name to notify them directly. Comments thread, and resolving one hides it without deleting it.
answers.Can multiple people edit a document at t: Yes. Edits sync live and each person's cursor is shown in their own color. If two people change the same line at once, both edits are kept and flagged so you can pick between them.
answers.Can I set an expiration date on a shared: Yes, on paid plans. When you create the link, open Link settings and set an expiry date, an optional password, and whether downloading is allowed. Expired links show a message rather than a broken page.
answers.Does this integrate with Slack?: Yes. Install the app from Settings > Integrations > Slack. Once connected you'll get notifications for comments and mentions in a channel you choose, and pasting a file link into Slack unfurls it with a preview for anyone who has access.
answers.How do I generate an API key?: Settings > Developer > API keys > Create key. The key is shown once and never again, so store it somewhere safe. Keys inherit your own permissions and can be scoped to read-only or revoked individually at any time.
answers.Can I connect this to Zapier?: Yes. Search for us in Zapier's app directory and authorize with your account. Triggers cover file created, file updated, and comment added; actions cover uploading files and creating share links.
answers.Can I sync this with my Google Calendar?: Yes, for files with due dates. Connect under Settings > Integrations > Google Calendar and pick which calendar to write to. The sync is one-way: changes here appear in Calendar, but Calendar edits don't come back.
answers.Do you support webhooks for event notifi: Yes, on paid plans. Register an endpoint under Settings > Developer > Webhooks and choose which events to receive. Every delivery is signed so you can verify it came from us, and failed deliveries retry with backoff for 24 hours.
answers.What's the rate limit on the API?: 1,000 requests per hour on free accounts and 10,000 on paid ones, counted per API key. Every response carries the remaining quota in a header, and exceeding the limit returns 429 with a retry-after value.
answers.How do I set up single sign-on for my co: SSO is available on enterprise plans and supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC. Configure it under Admin > Security > SSO by uploading your identity provider's metadata. We recommend keeping one non-SSO admin account as a fallback.
answers.Is there a mobile app for this?: Yes, for iOS and Android. Both support browsing, uploading, commenting, and offline access to files you've marked for it. Search and sharing work the same as on the web.
answers.Can I use the app without an internet co: Yes, for files you've marked Available offline. Those stay on the device and any edits you make sync automatically the next time you're online. Files not marked offline need a connection to open.
answers.What happens if I edit the same file off: Both versions are preserved. When the second device reconnects we keep its copy as a separate conflicted version rather than overwriting, and you pick which to keep from the file's History panel.
answers.How do I turn off desktop notifications?: Settings > Notifications > Desktop, then switch off the categories you don't want. You can also disable them at the operating system level, which overrides whatever is set here.
answers.How do I update the app to the latest ve: The desktop app updates itself in the background and applies the update on next launch. To check manually, use Help > Check for updates. Mobile apps update through the App Store or Play Store.
answers.Does the app work well on tablets?: Yes. The tablet layout uses a two-pane view with the file list alongside the preview, and supports drag and drop, split screen, and external keyboards including the standard shortcuts.
answers.Can I add a widget to my home screen?: Yes, on both iOS and Android. The widget shows recent files and a quick upload button. Add it the usual way for your platform by long-pressing the home screen and choosing our app from the widget list.
answers.How do I turn off email notifications?: Settings > Notifications > Email, then switch off whichever categories you don't want. Every notification email also has an unsubscribe link at the bottom that turns off that specific type.
answers.How do I get notified when someone menti: Mentions are on by default across email, desktop, and mobile. Adjust which channels they use under Settings > Notifications > Mentions. Mentions ignore Do Not Disturb unless you turn that off explicitly.
answers.Can I change how often I get summary ema: Yes. Settings > Notifications > Summary lets you choose daily, weekly, or off. Daily summaries arrive at 8am in your account's timezone, and weekly ones on Monday morning.
answers.Can I change the notification sound?: On mobile, yes, under Settings > Notifications > Sound. On desktop the sound comes from your operating system's notification settings rather than from us, so change it there.
answers.Can I temporarily pause all notification: Yes. Use Do Not Disturb from the bell icon and pick a duration or a custom schedule. Paused notifications aren't lost, they're collected and delivered as a summary when the pause ends.
answers.Can I see an audit log of account activi: Yes, on paid plans, under Settings > Security > Activity log. It records sign-ins, file access, permission changes, and share link creation. Enterprise plans keep two years of history and can export it as CSV.
answers.Is my data encrypted?: Yes. Files are encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Encryption keys are rotated regularly and managed separately from the stored data. Enterprise plans can supply their own keys.
answers.How do I request deletion of my data und: Email privacy@example.com from your account address, or use Settings > Privacy > Request data deletion. We confirm within 30 days as the regulation requires, and the request covers backups as well as live data.
answers.How do I access the admin console for my: If you have an admin role, the Admin link appears in the account menu. It covers members, security policy, billing, and the audit log. If you don't see it, ask an existing admin to grant you the role.
answers.Can I restrict account access to specifi: Yes, on enterprise plans, under Admin > Security > IP allowlist. Ranges are entered in CIDR form. Add your current address before saving, since an allowlist that excludes you locks you out immediately.
answers.Can I automatically provision new employ: Yes, with SCIM on enterprise plans. Once connected to your identity provider, accounts are created, updated, and deactivated automatically as people join, change roles, or leave. Configure it under Admin > Security > Provisioning.
answers.Are you SOC 2 compliant?: Yes, SOC 2 Type II, audited annually. We're also ISO 27001 certified. Current reports are available under a mutual NDA, which you can request from Settings > Security > Compliance documents.
answers.How do I contact customer support?: Use the Help menu inside the app to open a ticket, or email support@example.com. Paid plans include live chat during business hours, and enterprise plans have a dedicated contact with a one-hour response target.
answers.What are your customer support hours?: Email support is staffed 9am to 6pm Eastern on weekdays, with a typical first response within one business day. Enterprise plans include 24/7 coverage for urgent issues. The status page is updated at any hour during an incident.
answers.Is there a status page to check for outa: Yes, at status.example.com. It shows current uptime for every component and a history of past incidents, and you can subscribe there for email or SMS alerts when something is degraded.
answers.How do I submit a feature request?: Use Help > Suggest a feature in the app, or post on the community forum where others can vote. Requests with the most votes are reviewed by the product team each month.
answers.Do you have a public roadmap of upcoming: Yes, at roadmap.example.com. It's grouped into shipped, in progress, and planned. Dates are deliberately left off items that aren't already in progress, since they tend to move.
answers.Is there a community forum for users?: Yes, at community.example.com. It's a good place for workflow questions and tips from other users. Staff read it daily, but anything account-specific or urgent should go through support instead.
answers.Can I customize the color theme or appea: Yes. Settings > Appearance offers light, dark, and system themes, plus an accent color and a compact density option. The choice is per-device rather than per-account.
answers.Do you support keyboard shortcuts for co: Yes, extensively. Press ? anywhere to see the full list. The common ones are ctrl+K for search, U for upload, and / to jump to the file list. Shortcuts can be remapped under Settings > Accessibility.
answers.Does the app support screen readers for: Yes. We target WCAG 2.1 AA and test with VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. The file list, editor, and comments are all fully navigable by keyboard with announced landmarks. Report anything that doesn't work to support and it's treated as a bug.
answers.Can I change the language the interface: Yes. Settings > Language currently offers English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Japanese. This changes the interface only; your file names and content are left exactly as you wrote them.
